services.name: Mid Day Island Tour
services.desc: Our Mid-day Island tour is our 2.5-hour island tour but is offered in the afternoon. The afternoon tours might involve more strenuous kayaking due to a higher chance of wind. The Mid-Day Island Tour is our award-winning 2.5-Hour Island Tour but is offered when there is a higher chance of wind. The mid-day tour is still a great option but might require more strength and ability than our morning tours. This tour can still offer all of the same wildlife sightings and experiences as the morning tours. This is still a great tour option, but not for younger children or kayakers approaching the 2.5 Hours • Ages 15 & up

services.name: Island Kayak Tour
services.desc: Our Most Popular Trip! Availability Availability Is per person. If one spot is available it means there is room for one person, not one tandem kayak. 2 hour and 30 minutes About - Must have at least one 14 year old per kayak Our most popular tour to date! Our 2.5 hour Island Tour is the perfect trip for the beginner to get their feet wet. This tours paddles around the protected Frisco Bay with abundant wildlife, small islands and a protected shoreline you can't ask for a better area to paddle. For the past 4 years, this tour has included a short stop near a nesting pair of Bald Ages 6 & up • 2.5 Hrs • 8am, 8:30am, 9am

services.name: Family Kayak Tour
services.desc: The Perfect Family Trip! Children are required to book this tour. Our 2.5 hour Island tour at the earliest time available is great for beginner adults Availability Availability Is per person. If one spot is available it means there is room for one person, not one tandem kayak. 1.5 - 2 Hours About This is a family-focused tour with discounts for children ages 6-12. This tour departs daily out of the Frisco Bay Marina. We will paddle through the Giberson Bay Islands heading towards the Meadow Creek Preserve. Here you will expect to see Ospreys, waterfowl, and the occasional Mule deer. 1.5 - 2 Hours • Children must be present

services.name: Sunset Kayak Tour
services.desc: Best Sunset Views! 1.5 - 2 Hours About This tour is the perfect end to the perfect day on vacation. Enjoy Dillon Reservoir once the weather has pushed through and all we are left with are gorgeous views and glass calm water. Witness eagles, Ospreys and Mallards returning home for the night and capture a Summit County sunset as we head back just in time for Caribbean inspired cuisine at the marina's Island Grill. Offered on Friday only, with a chance to reschedule to Saturday if the weather is poor on Friday • Best Sunset Views!
